from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial report data point for comparison."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code if provided")
    current_liabilities_total: float | None = Field(description="The '流动负债合计' value from the balance sheet")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    currency: str = Field(default="元", description="Currency unit of the financial figures")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the figure if available")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level container for all company financial data points."""
    company_financial_reports: list[CompanyFinancialReport]
